summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting its June 2026 traffic statistics, showing a 7% year-over-year increase to 21.2 million passengers, a new monthly record. This is a routine operational update with no terms, consideration, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics applicable. The filing is a standard current report on Form 6-K providing monthly traffic data. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is purely operational and not a special situation.
